dedupe_keys.name: nasa zappy open source load flow library on openmdao with analytic derivatives for gradient based power system design optimisation

description: Zappy is a NASA Glenn Research Center Python library for electrical power system analysis built on the OpenMDAO multidisciplinary design framework, released as open source through the NASA Software Catalog (case LEW-20150-1, version 0.1 of March 2021). Contents: modular code for standard power system studies (load flow) that also returns analytic derivatives, or sensitivities, of the results to the user, which makes it efficient inside external programs that perform broader multidisciplinary optimisation of electrical power systems. Producer: NASA Glenn, catalogued under aeronautics. Coverage: generic. Format and access: open source Python library for Windows, Linux and macOS, with the code linked from the catalogue. Licence: NASA open source release (terms in the repository). Caveats: an early 0.1 release whose catalogue entry gives no validation cases, and it is not a replacement for utility-scale grid planning tools. Simulation uses: gradient-based optimisation of microgrid and distribution network design with sensitivities, coupling power flow with thermal or mission models, and teaching sensitivity-based design. Related records: the Modelica PowerSystems library (model-modelica-powersystems-library) offers dynamic power system models.
